sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
res = action(['UP','UP','RIGHT','RIGHT'])
a = current_frame
lines = a.ascii.split('\n')
def runs(rowstr, chars):
    out=[]; s=None
    for i,ch in enumerate(rowstr):
        if ch in chars:
            if s is None: s=i
        else:
            if s is not None: out.append((s,i-1)); s=None
    if s is not None: out.append((s,len(rowstr)-1))
    return out
for r in range(6,56):
    s=runs(lines[r],'S')
    if s: print('S at row',r,s)
print('level:', a.level, 'step:', a.step)
print(last_action_result.get('level_completed'), last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
